messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Plan the work first. Then hand each task to its own subagent with the context it needs, and don't edit the code yourself.

Added **Deal name** under **Reproduce a game**. Exported saves now restore the name when loaded.

Fixed valid pasted saves being rejected because their JSON fields appeared in a different order. Older unnamed saves remain compatible.

All code changes were delegated to three subagents. Typecheck, build, **153 unit/static tests**, and **83 browser journeys** passed.

Changed files pass formatting. Repository-wide formatting flags 23 preexisting files; Open Forge’s optional diagnostic failed internally with `ArgumentException`.
